tests.name: 只读盘点 OS / .NET SDK+Framework / 已安装 AutoCAD 年份-补丁-语言 / 现有 CAD 会话
tests.expected: 列出全部已安装完整 AutoCAD 宿主及精确 build；不启动或关闭用户 CAD
tests.actual: 15 个独立安装 + 6 个嵌套/补丁目录命中；.NET Framework 4.8.09037；SDK 10.0.400/9.0.314；盘点期间观察到 PID 3836 用户会话，未做任何操作，其后由用户自行关闭

tests.name: 锁定官方 MCP SDK / Host LTS / Schema / CLI / 日志 / 检索 / DAP 候选库
tests.expected: 读取实际版本、许可证、依赖；记录选择理由与不采用项；不引入 Python/Node 生产进程
tests.actual: Host=net10.0, Legacy=net48, Modern=net8.0-windows established from real host runtimeconfig evidence. MCP C# SDK 2.2.0 confirmed to exist. Schema/search/logging selections remain unlocked. Rejected: shipping Autodesk DLLs; Python/Node production processes.
tests.blocked_reason: Schema validation library, local search library and logging library are NOT yet locked. MCP SDK 2.2.0 version existence is confirmed but its metadata/dependencies/licence are only partly verified. Per the implementation plan, P0 exit requires every selection to have a source and a licence decision, so this item is not PASS.

tests.name: 锁定 DESIGN Sxx 来源到 tag/commit/file hash，逐项登记 LICENSE/NOTICE，厂商二进制不入包
tests.expected: 每个来源有可复算的 commit 与许可证据；未查清许可不复制
tests.actual: 由独立只读审计子代理执行，产出 source-register.json / source-register-summary.md；本地 Autodesk ObjectARX SDK 许可文件存在性一并登记
tests.progress_note: Source/licence audit completed by an independent read-only subagent; outputs in raw/source-register.json and raw/source-register-summary.md. Result was reviewed, and two of its conclusions were corrected in docs/design/dependency-lock.md (net48 asset reasoning, and Autodesk redistribution framing).

tests.name: 建立代码目录建议、测试框架与证据布局；保留并审查非空工作树
tests.expected: 目录规划与证据路径约定建立；不擅自初始化仓库或提交用户改动
tests.actual: 建立 src/ tests/ tools/ docs/design/ docs/evidence/ 骨架与 .gitignore；未初始化 git；原工作树仅含 5 个文档，已全部 hash 记录

tests.name: 确定真机矩阵实际可用组合；缺失版本记 BLOCKED 不标 unsupported
tests.expected: 逐版本记录实际 install/build/runtime/adapter；缺失者明确 BLOCKED
tests.actual: 12 个支持范围内独立安装；2015/2019/2021 记 BLOCKED_NO_LOCAL_INSTALL；2026 UPDATE 级别未定记 BLOCKED；2025 adapter 缺失记待查；产出兼容矩阵初稿

tests.name: DAP 端点定位（工程性补充探查）
tests.expected: 在写调试客户端前确定真正提供 DAP 请求处理的进程/模块
tests.actual: vl_u.crx engine_score=9/9 为唯一完整 DAP 引擎；AutoLispDebugAdapter.exe 仅含握手与 processId/program。全目录扫描 2367 文件，其余高分命中为 Roslyn/Qt/JS 噪声

tests.name: A01 前置安全基线快照（before）
tests.expected: 记录 SECURELOAD/TRUSTEDPATHS/LISPSYS 等启动前后可比对基线
tests.actual: 19 个 profile 已记录；SECURELOAD 既存为 0 于多个 profile；发现历史 agent 创建的 Codex* profile；本项目未修改任何值。据此 A01 的 SECURELOAD 阻挡负例记为 BLOCKED

tests.name: 2015 / 2019 / 2021 真机验证
tests.expected: 该年份真机加载、查询、写、Lisp、调试
tests.actual: 本机未安装该年份宿主
tests.blocked_reason: BLOCKED_NO_LOCAL_INSTALL — 执行 AI 不自行安装 CAD；处置待项目所有者裁决（Q-2）

tests.name: SECURELOAD 策略阻挡加载负例（A01/A18）

tests.actual: 现场 SECURELOAD 已为 0；本项目禁止为制造负例而修改该设置
tests.blocked_reason: 需在独立受控机器/账户上验证，或在授权下临时调整后再恢复；不得伪造

tests.name: 2025 官方调试能力判定

tests.actual: 2025 宿主目录无 AutoLispDebugAdapter.exe，但同为 Modern 宿主
tests.blocked_reason: BLOCKED_PENDING_INVESTIGATION — 需确认官方分发/安装前提，不能由文件缺失推断'不支持'
